description: 8-second vertical video featuring three UFOs (U+1F6F8) flying across a gold-on-void canvas. Particles trail behind each ship, converging into the æ:// glyph at the end. Deterministic render via CDP + CuPy, supervised by SupervisorVideo.

scenes.description: Three UFOs emerge from void at bottom, begin slow ascent with particle trails
UFOs fly in triangular formation across the frame, leaving gold particle trails
UFOs converge at center, particles form æ glyph, all fade to gold glow
